_key.description: Variant key, Ensembl protein ID, motif concordance with spaces rewritten to underscore, ADASTRA, and the GTRD cell identifier, joined by underscores.

chr.description: Chromosome of the variant, prefixed with chr.

motif_fc.description: Log2 ratio of HOCOMOCO motif p-values for the reference versus alternate allele. Positive values mean the motif prefers the alternate allele; negative values prefer the reference.

motif_pos.description: 0-based position of the variant relative to the best HOCOMOCO PWM hit.

motif_orient.description: Strand of the best HOCOMOCO PWM hit relative to the reference assembly.

motif_conc.description: Whether the allelic read imbalance agrees with the motif fold-change, assessed at 25% FDR.

motif.description: HOCOMOCO v11 motif for the transcription factor, as a handle into motifs.

es_mean_ref.description: Allele-wise effect size for the reference allele: weighted mean of log2(observed/expected) allelic read counts. Larger values mean stronger reference-allele ASB.

es_mean_alt.description: Allele-wise effect size for the alternate allele: weighted mean of log2(observed/expected) allelic read counts. Larger values mean stronger alternate-allele ASB.

p_value_adj_ref.description: Benjamini–Hochberg FDR of the logit-aggregated p-value for reference-allele ASB.

p_value_adj_alt.description: Benjamini–Hochberg FDR of the logit-aggregated p-value for alternate-allele ASB.

neg_log10_pvalue_adj_ref.description: Negative log10 of the FDR-adjusted p-value for reference-allele ASB. Larger values mean stronger evidence.

neg_log10_pvalue_adj_alt.description: Negative log10 of the FDR-adjusted p-value for alternate-allele ASB. Larger values mean stronger evidence.

biological_context.description: GTRD name of the cell type the ASB was called in.

biosample_term.description: Ontology term for that cell type, as a handle into ontology_terms.

biological_process.description: Gene Ontology term for regulation of DNA binding, as a handle into ontology_terms.

files_filesets.description: Handle of the files_filesets record for the IGVF file this ASB table was read from.

accessible_via.return: motif, motif_fc, neg_log10_pvalue_adj_ref, neg_log10_pvalue_adj_alt, biological_context, label, biosample_term, source, source_url, method, class, files_filesets
